product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash warm, tumble dry medium

reviews.author: Patrick O'Brien
reviews.comment: One of my favorite shirts this season. The plaid pattern is bold and the flannel is super soft. Great for layering in autumn.

reviews.author: Marcus Lee
reviews.comment: Solid flannel shirt. Fits well and the fabric feels premium. Could use one more button on the cuff.

reviews.author: Tobias Grant
reviews.comment: Great quality checkered shirt. True to size and very comfortable for all-day wear.

faqs.question: Is this shirt suitable for layering?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! The regular fit makes it perfect to wear open over a t-shirt or fully buttoned on its own.

faqs.question: Does this shirt shrink after washing?
faqs.answer: The fabric is pre-washed to minimize shrinkage. We recommend washing on a warm, not hot, cycle.

faqs.question: Is the collar stiff or soft?
faqs.answer: The collar is semi-structured — firm enough to hold its shape but soft enough to stay comfortable all day.

product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash cold, hang dry, iron on medium heat

reviews.author: Sebastian Moore
reviews.comment: Stunning shirt. The linen fabric is breathable and the mandarin collar gives it a sophisticated, minimal look.

reviews.author: Julian Harte
reviews.comment: Best shirt I own. The vertical stripes are subtle and elegant. Perfect for both casual and smart-casual outfits.

reviews.author: Freddie Armstrong
reviews.comment: Exceptional quality. The green color is exactly as shown. Feels luxurious and drapes beautifully.

faqs.question: Does linen wrinkle easily?
faqs.answer: Linen naturally wrinkles but this adds to its relaxed, casual charm. A light iron on medium heat will smooth it out if preferred.

faqs.question: Is this shirt see-through?
faqs.answer: The fabric has a medium weave that is not fully opaque. Wearing a light undershirt is recommended in bright lighting.

faqs.question: Is the mandarin collar comfortable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the band collar is designed to sit close to the neck without being restrictive, making it comfortable for extended wear.

reviews.author: Nate Simmons
reviews.comment: Good skinny jeans with a nice amount of stretch. The distressed details look authentic and not overdone.

reviews.author: Kyle Patterson
reviews.comment: Decent jeans but the waistband is a little snug. Would suggest sizing up. Color is great though.

reviews.author: Rhys Davidson
reviews.comment: Average quality for the price point. Fit is good but the denim feels thinner than expected.

faqs.question: Are the distressed details pre-made or will they develop over time?
faqs.answer: The distressing is pre-made and factory-treated, so the jeans arrive with that worn-in look right out of the box.

faqs.question: Do these jeans stretch out over time?
faqs.answer: The elastane content helps them retain their shape. They may relax slightly after a full day of wear but return to shape after washing.

faqs.question: Are these suitable for colder weather?
faqs.answer: They work year-round. For colder months, we recommend pairing them with thermal underlayers for extra warmth.

product_details.care_instructions: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low

reviews.author: Caleb Jordan
reviews.comment: These are the best black jeans I've ever owned. The faded wash gives them a cool, worn-in look that pairs with everything.

reviews.author: Evan Price
reviews.comment: Great jeans. Slim and comfortable with just the right amount of stretch. Very stylish for the price.

reviews.author: Aidan Ross
reviews.comment: Really happy with these jeans. The faded finish looks premium and the fit is perfect.

faqs.question: Will the faded effect wash out over time?
faqs.answer: The faded effect is a permanent fabric treatment and is designed to maintain its look with proper care.

faqs.question: Are these jeans suitable for formal wear?
faqs.answer: These work best for smart-casual looks. Pair them with a blazer and dress shoes for a polished semi-formal appearance.

faqs.question: Do these jeans have stretch?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 2% elastane blend provides comfortable stretch and ensures the jeans retain their shape after repeated wear.
